highlights.reason_zh: 三家供应商被下线、125 个 endpoint 失去 ZDR 资格，直接改变模型路由的数据边界。
highlights.reason_en: Three provider removals and 125 ZDR revocations materially change model-router data boundaries.

highlights.reason_zh: 应用开始拒绝系统级 AI agent 截屏，说明用户授权不再自动覆盖敏感应用边界。
highlights.reason_en: Apps now reject OS-level agent capture, showing that user consent no longer automatically overrides sensitive-app boundaries.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开多尺寸音视频权重和部署配方，直接降低本地联合理解试验门槛。
highlights.reason_en: Public audio-video weights and recipes lower the barrier to local joint-understanding trials.

highlights.reason_zh: 状态权限、恢复证据和日志清洗会直接影响长时程 agent 的故障边界。
highlights.reason_en: State permissions, recovery evidence and log sanitization directly affect long-running-agent failure boundaries.

highlights.reason_zh: 无密钥部署认证变化可能造成升级后 401，网关团队需要提前迁移。
highlights.reason_en: A keyless-auth change can cause post-upgrade 401s and requires gateway migration.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 36/36 成功并完成阅读；主动覆盖模型/API、开发工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、中文材料、小团队与重大综合新闻。两项补录只有日期精度；OpenRouter 事件保留上游归属限制，厂商 benchmark 尚待独立复现；未选入重大综合新闻例外。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read. Active discovery covered models and APIs, developer tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, Chinese-language sources, small teams and exceptional general news. Two late discoveries have date-only precision; the OpenRouter incident retains upstream attribution limits and publisher benchmarks await independent reproduction; no exceptional general-news item was selected.
